tools.name: find_best_australian_exchange
tools.description: Compare Australian cryptocurrency exchanges to identify the best estimated buying or selling outcome for a specified asset, AUD trade amount and direction. Use this tool when the user wants to compare exchange prices, fees or estimated value received. For simply finding exchanges that offer a crypto

tools.name: find_where_to_buy_crypto
tools.description: Find Australian cryptocurrency exchanges offering a specified cryptocurrency for purchase using AUD. Use this tool when the user wants to know where an asset can be bought or which Australian exchanges offer it. For comparing the best estimated buy or sell outcome across exchanges, use find_best_aus

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.detail: Tool "find_best_australian_exchange" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find the best Australian cryptocurrency exchange for a specified asset, AUD amount, and buy or sell direction. This is a paid CryptoBuddy x402 service supporting XRP payments on XRPL Mainnet and USDC payments on Base Mainnet." → after: "Compare Australian cryptocurrency exchanges to identify the best estimated buying or selling outcome for a specified asset, AUD trade amount and direction. Use this tool when the user wants to compare exchange prices, fees or estimated value received. For simply finding exchanges that offer a crypto"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
